scripts.dev: npm run switcher:build && npm -C electron run dev
scripts.switcher:install: npm run switcher:build && mkdir -p electron/bin && cp switcher/clovapi electron/bin/clovapi && chmod +x electron/bin/clovapi && echo Installed local clovapi to switcher/clovapi and electron/bin/clovapi
scripts.switcher:install-global: npm run switcher:build && sh -c 'target=$(command -v clovapi); test -n "$target" || exit 1; rm -f "$target"; cp switcher/clovapi "$target" && chmod +x "$target" && echo Installed to "$target"' && npm run switcher:install
